description: Devinci’s kids bikes may be small, but they don’t skimp when it comes to copping the same high-performance features that define our mom- and dad-size rides. The intrepid Ewoc, for instance, is off-road equipped with lightweight Optimum G02 aluminum tubing and advanced geometries perfect for pint-size rippers. The Azkhaban, on the other hand, is a multitasking wizard, mirroring Devinci’s performance hybrid bikes and built on an Optimum S02 aluminum platform. Both models feature lifetime frame warranties and high-viz color schemes to ensure kids are seen, and therefore safe.
